text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — policy=latency.p95.us-west, condition=p95>210ms, count=6m, link=https://pagerduty.local/alerts/PD-1843210001

maya: acked. on it.

maya: seeing sustained p95 ~480ms on us-west inference cluster (redwood-runtime-01). tail spikes during decode step.

sam: copying in — any deploys in the last 4h?
maya: none since 3h ago, config/rollouts quiet.

jess: checking autoscaler + node health now.

jess: autoscaler stable, but GPU mem pressure high on gpu-pool-3. OOM evictions observed on a few pods.

ryan: rebalancing traffic away from gpu-pool-3 to gpu-pool-1. plan: run reroute then monitor. command: `ri-router reroute --from=gpu-pool-3 --to=gpu-pool-1 --apply`

maya: running reroute apply now — will watch p95/p99.

support-bot: customer-impact summary: ~12 customers (low-medium usage) showing elevated latency (500ms+ tail) in us-west. no 5xx spikes.

sam: short-term mitigation idea — enable prefix/KV cache for the hot model to reduce repeated decode cost.

maya: applying cache change: ```rictl patch service inference-model-x --set cache.prefix=true --set cache.max_entries=50000``` applied; warming caches.

maya: after reroute+cache: p95 ~230ms, p99 still high (~1200ms) for a subset of long-sequence requests.

jess: digging into slow traces — subset of requests have seq_len>2048 and hit unoptimized attention kernels. fallback to quantized/fast model might help.

sam: I can build a quantized canary (~12m). alternative: fallback route to model-x-v0.9-fast (lower quality, faster). recommend fallback to reduce user impact while canary builds.

maya: initiating fallback policy: `ri-router set-fallback model-x model-x-v0.9-fast --percent=50`

maya: traffic shifted to fallback 50%. observability: p95=195ms, p99=540ms. customer errors still 0.

ryan: adding autoscaler headroom +2 GPUs to us-west: `autoscaler scale --pool us-west --delta +2` — should reduce memory pressure as nodes replenish cache warmup.

ashley: support -> will notify top-5 affected customers with a brief note and ask for reports. drafting now.

maya: incident status = ongoing; timeline & actions recorded in incident doc https://docs.internal/incidents/1843210001. Handoff planned at 06:30 UTC to @jess.

jess: ack for handoff, will take over monitoring and will follow up with post-incident notes. good triage everyone :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved — policy=latency.p95.us-west condition cleared.
